name: 终极地狱-轩辕传说
english_description: A stripped-down 'base engine' snapshot of the same Doing Lu 'hell' ES II-lineage codebase as this collection's hell/hellxg/zjmudhell, self-titled 终极地狱-轩辕传说 (Ultimate Hell: Legend of Xuanyuan) and opening on the banner 'EMPEROR OF ULTRA HELL (BLOOD & MAGIC) FROM 1999.12.12.' Only three domains ship in this particular release -- the reincarnation/afterlife hall, the arena (pk), and the registration entry -- rather than the roughly 54 city and sect domains of the full hell release, though the shared engine's own registration flow, combat system, and daemons are all intact. New characters go through the lineage's classic reincarnation ritual: an English login id, an optional Chinese surname and given name, dual admin/regular passwords, a 1-5 aptitude choice (猛士/智慧/耐力/敏捷/均衡), and a gender choice, arriving in the 世外桃源 (Peach Blossom Land) entry scene where the NPC 水笙 greets newly arrived souls and nudges them toward the register command to claim an email address for password recovery.
